description: This file contains functions for verifying the URL resolution of the '/api/users' endpoint, primarily used for development and testing purposes. It constructs the URL based on organization context, logs verification details, and includes a helper for quick resolution testing.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the URL for the '/api/users' endpoint with organization ID, optionally overriding the current organization, and performs validation in non-production environments.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: Helper function that calls verifyUsersUrlResolution with a preset organization ID ('T0015') for quick validation/testing.
